items.label: Perfect Outdoor Patio Furniture Set
items.value: This 4-piece outdoor patio furniture set includes a loveseat, two single chairs, and a tempered glass coffee table, creating a cozy seating area for your patio, garden, poolside, backyard, or balcony. Ideal for outdoor conversations, relaxing, and entertaining guests in style.

items.label: Ergonomic & Comfortable Design
items.value: Designed with gently curved backrests that fit your body perfectly, this patio set provides excellent support for your shoulders and back. The wide seats and smooth armrests offer superior comfort for long hours of outdoor relaxation.

items.label: Durable Textilene Fabric & Metal Frame
items.value: Made with breathable, quick-drying Textilene sling fabric and a powder-coated steel frame, this outdoor furniture set is rust-resistant, weather-resistant, and built for long-term outdoor use. The tempered glass tabletop is easy to clean and sturdy for daily use.

items.label: Perfect for Multiple Outdoor Spaces
items.value: This minimalist patio conversation set blends effortlessly with modern and classic outdoor décor. Perfect for patios, gardens, poolside areas, porches, decks, and balconies, adding style and comfort to any outdoor space.

items.label: Easy Assembly & Stable Structure
items.value: Comes with clear instructions and all necessary hardware for quick and easy assembly. Non-slip foot pads enhance stability and protect your floor, ensuring safe and worry-free outdoor use.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe together, Wipe with Damp Cloth

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Follow the detailed instruction manual provided to assemble the furniture set. The set comes with all necessary tools and hardware for a simple and hassle-free assembly process.
